sources.title: Visas para extranjeros: country classification
sources.publisher: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores de Guatemala
sources.officialityEvidence: MINEX is Guatemala's competent foreign ministry, and this nationality-classification endpoint is on its official .gob.gt domain. The live endpoint is Cloudflare-protected in this review environment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Categoría “A” Exento; Categoría “B” Visa consular; Categoría “C” Visa consultada.

sources.title: Clasificación de países
sources.officialityEvidence: IGM is Guatemala's national migration authority and its live official page defines the three visitor-visa categories.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los países que se encuentran en la categoría A, no necesitan visa para ingresar al territorio guatemalteco.

sources.title: Consultas frecuentes para trámite de visas guatemaltecas
sources.officialityEvidence: IGM's live official visa FAQ says Category B and C foreign nationals must apply and distinguishes consular issuance from Institute consultation.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Las personas extranjeras que se encuentren clasificadas dentro de las categorías “B” y “C”

conflicts.explanation: Guatemala's current Foreign Ministry schedule places Andorra in both visa-exempt Category A and consular-visa Category B, so it does not establish one ordinary-passport result.

unresolved.reason: The controlling current MINEX schedule places Andorra in both Category A and Category B. The official category guidance cannot reconcile those contradictory ordinary-passport results, so neither baseline is inferred.

MINEX's United Kingdom wording addresses certain British passports connected to Hong Kong, not an HKSAR ordinary passport. No current Guatemalan primary source directly maps this passport, and no substitute-document inference is made.

No current Guatemalan primary source directly classifies an ordinary Macao SAR passport. China or other special-document wording, omission from a schedule and conditional visa-holder routes do not establish a baseline.

Kosovo is not expressly named in the current Guatemalan ordinary-passport categories. The categories and generic advance-visa process do not create an inferred residual rule or resolve document-recognition treatment.

The current schedule's Sudan row does not directly classify an ordinary South Sudan passport. No current Guatemalan or South Sudanese authority supplies a separate visitor route; a legacy-name or complement inference is excluded.
